summary: INT. SHARDFALL CITADEL — ARENA VAULT — NIGHT. A vast, circular hall—no roaring crowds, only the hum of forges behind steel.

dialogueInline.speaker: Captain
dialogueInline.text: The Verge riots. They demand food—

dialogueInline.text: Words do not lead. They follow.

directionInline: A vast, circular hall—no roaring crowds, only the hum of forges behind steel. Chrome tiers descend toward a floor scored with duel-lines. Braziers burn cold blue.
